name: Northwest Pipeline Rockies Expansion
researcher_notes: Checked the roster: Northwest Gas Pipeline has rows for the main line, Trail West, Kalama Lateral, Kelso-Beaver and Wild Trail, but none for this 2003 project, so it is not an existing row under another name. The August 2026 EIA release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 303, lists NWPL Rockies Expansion by Northwest Pipeline Co: completed November 2003, 91 miles of 26 and 30 inch pipe, 175 MMcf/d of added capacity, cost 139.4 million dollars, FERC docket CP01-438, states WY, UT, ID, OR and WA. The 91 miles are about 146 km, above the 25 km threshold. This is one source from one publisher; a second source such as the FERC certificate order was not searched, so tier is high on one validated reference. Start and end states are the first and last states in the EIA list and the exact start and end points were not found, so StartLocation and EndLocation are blank. Parent system is owned by Williams Companies per the existing roster rows, but the EIA entry does not name Williams, so Parent is not staged. Owner spelling follows the source because no legal form was found. Piping is loops, so route is not found: RouteType unavailable, RouteAccuracy no route. Diameter is two sizes, 26 and 30 inches. Sheet field names for start year and diameter delimiter should be checked at merge.
